1986 # Tech Seed originated as the Taichung office of Tex Year Industrial Co., Ltd. The primary business involved distributing hot melt adhesives, cyanoacrylate adhesives, AB adhesives, anaerobic adhesives, and other products manufactured by Tex Year. Additionally, the company imported select specialty adhesives and chemicals from the United States and Japan.
1994 # Tech Seed Company was officially established as a subsidiary of Tex Year Group. The company continued to distribute Tex Year products while expanding its services to include application consulting and after-sales support.
1995 # Building on its foundation in adhesives and specialty chemicals, Tech Seed broadened its product portfolio to include industrial filtration materials such as filter cartridges, filter bags, and filter housings. This expansion enabled the company to offer more comprehensive solutions to its customers.
1998 # A major reorganization led to the formation of Tech Seed Enterprise Co., Ltd., marking its independence from Tex Year Group. To address increasing market demand, Tech Seed enhanced its sales of automatic marking systems—including dot matrix marking, laser marking, and inkjet printers. The company also began exporting its best-selling adhesives and filtration products to international markets. Four main business departments were established, each focusing on a specific product category: [Adhesion], [Filtration], [Machinery], and [Overseas Department].
2003 # Tech Seed formed a production and sales partnership with Filtteck, then Taiwan’s sole manufacturer specializing in melt-blown and pleated filter cartridges.
2009 # The company became the exclusive distributor in Taiwan for Japan’s Chiko Airtec Co., providing compact dust collectors and related after-sales services.
2014 # A marketing partnership was established with HOYA Corporation (Japan) to promote its full range of UV curing equipment in Taiwan.
2016 # Tech Seed set up the [Chemical Materials Department], expanding its offerings to include a broader range of industrial chemical products such as fire-stop materials, industrial putty, mold release agents, and industrial cleaners.

Building High-Performance Optoelectronics Production Environments # The optoelectronics industry demands exceptional standards for cleanliness, equipment reliability, and product accuracy. From panels and sensors to LEDs, optical lenses, and solar modules, every stage—material handling, bonding, packaging, and final testing—directly influences product brightness, stability, and lifespan.
To address these challenges, we offer integrated solutions that combine advanced equipment and materials, supporting manufacturers in achieving efficient production, precise process control, and compliance with international quality benchmarks.
Integrated Solutions for Optoelectronics Manufacturing # Process Filtration Systems
Our filtration solutions are tailored to the unique fluid management needs of optoelectronics facilities, from facility water to process-specific segments. These systems effectively remove particulate contaminants, ensuring that glass substrates and optical components remain uncontaminated throughout processing.
Dust Collection Equipment
High-performance dust collectors are engineered for laser processing, grinding, and cutting operations. They rapidly eliminate airborne particulates, protecting sensitive components. When paired with HEPA filters, these systems help maintain cleanroom standards.
Optoelectronics Adhesives
We provide a range of high-performance adhesives, including UV-curable, light guide, and packaging adhesives. These are ideal for panel bonding, lens module assembly, and LED packaging, offering high light transmittance, minimal bubble formation, and robust stability. All products comply with RoHS and other international standards.
Firestop Materials
Our firestop solutions address gaps in fire-rated partitions, penetrations through floors and ceilings, and around pipes and doors, supporting comprehensive facility safety.
Laser and Automated Marking Systems
Precision marking systems enable the application of batch numbers, QR codes, and process history on glass, metal, or plastic substrates. This ensures full traceability and supports international supply chain management requirements.
High-Precision Glue Dispensers
Our dispensers support micro-volume dispensing and multi-axis control, making them suitable for high-precision applications such as LCD backlight modules, lens assembly, and sensor bonding. These systems enhance glue application consistency and improve yield rates.
We recognize the industry’s ongoing pursuit of process cleanliness, optical quality, and yield optimization. Beyond supplying high-spec equipment and materials, we deliver integrated, customized solutions tailored to specific customer requirements. Our commitment is to strengthen product competitiveness, reduce delivery times, and stabilize production quality.
Contact us to explore how we can help you achieve a more precise, cleaner, and intelligent optoelectronics manufacturing environment.

Advancing Manufacturing Standards in Plastics and Rubber # The plastics and rubber sector covers a wide range of processes, including injection molding, extrusion, plastic processing, rubber product manufacturing, and composite material applications. Products from this industry are found in everyday items, industrial components, automotive interiors, and high-performance composites. As the industry faces increasing requirements for precision, cleanliness, and efficiency, manufacturers are seeking advanced, intelligent, and controllable production solutions.
We offer a suite of equipment and materials tailored for the plastics and rubber industry, supporting customers in improving process yield, minimizing contamination risks, and achieving automated, traceable, and high-quality production environments.
Key Solutions for Industry Challenges # Raw Material Filtration
For plastic pellets, rubber powders, and additives, we provide professional-grade filter bags and gas filtration systems. These solutions effectively prevent contamination and clumping of raw materials, ensuring consistent material quality and product uniformity.
Dust and Odor Treatment
To address dust, aerosols, and odors generated during extrusion, mixing, and injection molding, we supply high-efficiency dust collectors and odor adsorption systems. These systems help maintain operational cleanliness and support compliance with air pollution regulations.
Adhesives for Assembling
Our range includes strong, fast-drying adhesives and heat-resistant products with excellent flexibility and chemical resistance. These adhesives are suitable for assembling plastic parts and bonding rubber to metal composites, ensuring both structural stability and visual quality.
Firestop Materials
Our firestop materials are designed to reduce fire spread and smoke by up to 90%. They are low-odor, non-toxic, non-carcinogenic, and have no harmful side effects.
Marking & Tracing for Packages
For bagged, barrel-packaged, and modular plastic parts, our automatic marking systems enable comprehensive batch, production date, and specification labeling. This enhances warehouse management and supply chain traceability.
Smart Dispensing Equipment
Our automated dispensing systems support multi-angle application and multi-stage flow control. They are ideal for plastic module assembly, sealing pad coating, and composite part encapsulation, reducing human error and improving operational efficiency.
The plastics and rubber industry is under increasing pressure to meet high standards of cleanliness, stability, efficiency, and quality. Our approach combines high-specification products with integrated solutions tailored to specific process requirements and application scenarios.
For further information or to discuss how we can support your manufacturing goals, contact us.
